recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Biology for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: M.C. Michael

topics.topic: Genetics: Mendelian Laws of Inheritance & Monohybrid Crosses
subtopics: Gregor Mendel's experiments on Pisum sativum (garden peas)
First Law of Segregation: monohybrid crosses with complete dominance (3:1 phenotypic, 1:2:1 genotypic)
Genetic terms: dominant, recessive, homozygous, heterozygous, allele, phenotype, genotype, test cross
objectives: Construct Punnett squares for monohybrid crosses showing parental genotypes, gametes, F1, and F2 generations
Perform test crosses to determine the genotype of an organism displaying a dominant phenotype

topics.topic: Dihybrid Crosses, Incomplete Dominance and Codominance
subtopics: Mendel's Second Law of Independent Assortment: dihybrid cross yielding a 9:3:3:1 phenotypic ratio
Incomplete dominance (Mirabilis jalapa: red × white = pink 1:2:1)
Codominance: ABO blood group system (alleles I^A, I^B, I^O) and Roan cattle coat color
objectives: Draw Punnett squares for 2-trait dihybrid crosses
Differentiate incomplete dominance from codominance with biological examples
Predict offspring blood groups given parental genotypes

topics.topic: Human Genetics: Sex Determination, Sex Linkage & Sickle Cell Anemia
subtopics: Sex chromosomes (XX for females, XY for males) and 1:1 sex ratio determination
Sex-linked traits on X-chromosome: hemophilia (bleeder's disease) and red-green color blindness
Sickle cell hemoglobin (HbA and HbS): genotypes AA, AS, SS, and malaria resistance in heterozygotes
objectives: Trace inheritance of sex-linked hemophilia across pedigrees
Calculate statistical probabilities of carrier and sickle cell offspring
Advocate for pre-marital genotype testing in Nigerian communities

topics.topic: Biological Variation: Morphological vs Physiological Traits
subtopics: Continuous variation: height, weight, skin color (bell-shaped normal distribution curve)
Discontinuous variation: ABO blood groups, ability to roll tongue, presence of hitchhiker's thumb
Fingerprint patterns: arches, loops, whorls, composites, and forensic identification
objectives: Measure and plot histograms of heights of 40 students showing normal distribution
Survey class for tongue rolling ability and fingerprint types
Explain how biological variation provides raw material for natural selection

topics.topic: Theories of Evolution: Lamarckism and Darwinian Natural Selection
subtopics: Jean-Baptiste Lamarck's theory of use and disuse and inheritance of acquired characteristics
Charles Darwin's theory of natural selection: overproduction, struggle for existence, survival of the fittest
Modern synthetic theory of evolution, speciation, and evidence from comparative anatomy (homologous vs analogous structures)
objectives: Compare Lamarck's and Darwin's explanations for the long neck of the giraffe
Distinguish homologous structures (pentadactyl limb) from analogous structures (insect vs bird wing)
Cite industrial melanism in peppered moths as observable evidence of natural selection

topics.topic: Animal Behavior: Innate Instincts, Reflexes and Social Insects
subtopics: Innate vs learned behavior: simple reflexes, taxes, kineses, and instincts
Conditioned reflexes (Ivan Pavlov's classical conditioning experiments with dogs)
Social organization in insects: division of labor and castes in termites and honeybees
objectives: Draw and identify castes in a termite colony (king, queen, workers, soldiers)
Explain the biological significance of pheromone communication in social insect colonies

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Practical Laboratory Test
subtopics: Assessment on Mendelian genetics, sex linkage, variation, evolution, and termite castes
WASSCE mock specimen identification test
objectives: Demonstrate mastery of WAEC practical genetics and anatomical specimen drawing

topics.topic: Human Nervous System II & Endocrine Regulation
subtopics: Comparison of nervous coordination (fast, electrical, specific) with endocrine coordination (slow, chemical, systemic)
Endocrine glands: pituitary, thyroid, adrenal glands, pancreas (islets of Langerhans), gonads
Disorders caused by hypersecretion and hyposecretion (gigantism, dwarfism, diabetes mellitus, goiter)
objectives: Map endocrine glands on a human anatomical outline and state their hormones
Explain negative feedback regulation of blood glucose by insulin and glucagon
Discuss nutritional prevention of simple goiter using iodized salt in Nigeria

topics.topic: Sense Organs II: Advanced Optical Correction & Ear Acoustics
subtopics: Optical accommodation: ciliary muscle contraction and suspensory ligament tension
Correction of myopia (concave lens), hypermetropia (convex lens), presbyopia, and astigmatism
Anatomy of the cochlea, organ of Corti, and semicircular canals for auditory perception and balance
objectives: Draw ray diagrams illustrating short-sightedness and its optical correction using diverging lenses
Trace acoustic vibrations from the tympanic membrane across ossicles to the cochlea

topics.topic: Environmental Health: Crude Oil Spills, Eutrophication & Resource Conservation
subtopics: Ecological consequences of petroleum spillage in the Niger Delta mangrove creeks
Eutrophication: agricultural fertilizer run-off leading to algal blooms and fish death
Conservation of natural resources: national parks and game reserves in Nigeria (Yankari, Kainji Lake)
objectives: Analyze the biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) cascade during aquatic eutrophication
Formulate community conservation strategies to protect endangered Nigerian wildlife (gorillas, drill monkeys)

topics.topic: WASSCE Biology Practical Masterclass: Specimen Handling & Staining
subtopics: WAEC biological drawing rules (sharp HB pencil, no shading, ruled parallel label lines, magnification)
Alternative-to-practical test: biochemical food tests, bone identification, and transverse sections
Common candidate pitfalls highlighted in WAEC Chief Examiner Reports
objectives: Produce standardized drawings of biological specimens scoring full marks on magnification and labels
Execute rapid biochemical tests on unknown food solutions

topics.topic: Final WASSCE & NECO Mock Examination Clinic
subtopics: Full 3-year senior secondary biology examination simulation (Paper 1, Paper 2, Paper 3)
Scoring guide review and question elimination techniques
objectives: Complete senior secondary biology mock examination

subtopics: Final examination moderation and graduation certification
objectives: Complete Senior Secondary School Biology certification
